## First group of facts

State each fact once, here. Other pages link to this section and do not copy it.

Facts that come in sets go in a table with a fixed column order and a header row:

| Name | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `field` | string | none | What it holds and when it is set. |

An example that shows the shape goes in a code block with the language named:

```json
{ "field": "value" }
```
